name: note-app
description: A note-taking application with frontend and backend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start --prefix apps/server" "npm run start --prefix apps/web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/server && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/server && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix apps/server && npm run clean --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/server && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/server && npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/web
